input.summary: Caller discrepancies on four proposal points; request r2
input.message:
Caller independent comparison done; four discrepancies need a revised proposal. Save it as a NEW file work/criteria-review-01/specialist-proposal-r2.json (and specialist-report-r2.json); do not modify or delete specialist-proposal.json / specialist-report.json (they stay as the r1 record). Same hard limits as before: new files only, no store/PLAR/job writes, no provider tools.

D1 (substantive, transparent-exterior x3: working/retry/paused). Your measured clause "no cell may contain an alpha>0 region that reaches all four cell edges or fills the cell" is written as a rejection rule. It wrongly rejects a brief-conforming mark such as a corner-to-corner X or a full-height/width glyph whose single component touches all four cell edges while the exterior stays transparent. Demote it to a diagnostic that triggers the visual review (retain alpha histogram + RGBA component boxes; flag any component touching all four edges or covering more than N% of the cell for visual judgment), not a rejection condition. Keep as mechanical rejection only what is decidable: construction-scoped alpha-channel equality with cw^k(seed) under the seed-rotation construction. The visual record is the deciding rule for matte/tile/plate/fringe. Caller decision on your question 2: adopt the SPLIT (one measured/diagnostic record + one visual record) for any future plan; for the existing records this is documented correction only.

D2 (working.q.motion-continuity). You placed "evenly paced" inside the required outcome. BRIEF line 3 fixes four frames at 100 ms and that the loop communicates activity; it does not require equal motion increments per frame. Even pacing of motion (the near-hold clause) is an expert quality clause, not owner authority. Required outcome should be: plays as one continuous activity loop at the consumer's 100 ms/frame with no visible discontinuity at the fourth-to-first wrap. Move "evenly paced"/near-hold to the expert clause set (contract- or construction-scoped as you judge).

D3 (delivery.q.continuity). "comparable (not identical) visual weight" introduces a cross-member comparability restriction the sources do not state; the original "readable visual weight" is ambiguous in the other direction. Propose wording that keeps the brief's outcome without adding a comparability rule, e.g. "readable visual weight coherent with the Ready baseline; identical stroke width or footprint is not required" (render.choice.style not_fixed: stroke width, margins).

D4 (retry.q.retry-meaning-without-color, paused.q.pause-meaning-without-color, delivery.q.distinction; basis only). Distinction from the preserved Start triangle is not stated by BRIEF "Preserve the existing vector Start control". Its actual basis is that idle resolves to Start in the same status cells (src/queue-view.ts line 3 and lines 10-11), so "distinguishable without color alone" among the status visuals reasonably includes Start. Correct the basis text accordingly; keep the clause as requirement-by-reasonable-reading and say so.

Everything else: caller agrees (geometry clarification, frame-assembly bounds and construction-scoped cw^k clause as proposal, activity-not-success re-scoping, style-coherence anti-aliasing note, consumers/destination fixture + evidence-route corrections, keeps). Reduced motion: your questions 1 are owner/caller design decisions outside this review repair; the caller does not adopt P1/M1 here and records them as the specialist's labelled proposals with the decisions left open; the animated strip remains required per BRIEF line 3 and AUTHORING-UPDATE.md.

Return: paths + sha256 of the r2 files, a short old-to-new list for D1-D4, and confirmation that r1 files and all historical files are unchanged (re-hash state.px 3484cf38..., authoring-plar 7c6c54fb..., plar a462ecf3..., AUTHORING-RESULT 3724bfa7...).
